lanes.name: Salaried career
evidence: The role supplies current income and a promotion packet is due this quarter.
Recent work has built transferable stakeholder and execution skills.
lanes.notes: Protect the income base but cap overtime.

lanes.name: Portfolio product
evidence: Three target users described the same workflow problem.
A working prototype would remain useful as technical and product proof.
lanes.notes: Use the sprint to test the problem, not to build a full company.

lanes.name: Educational publishing
evidence: Past posts generated useful conversations but no reliable revenue.
Editing time has recently grown faster than audience learning.
lanes.notes: Maintain the publishing habit without treating attention as the destination.

lanes.name: Freelance consulting
evidence: Two former colleagues have asked about short paid engagements.
Discovery calls would improve customer and market understanding.
lanes.notes: Use a bounded offer instead of open-ended client work.

lanes.name: Open exploration
evidence: Uncommitted research has repeatedly produced useful project ideas.
The value is real but difficult to attribute to a single sprint.
lanes.notes: Keep a protected floor and require a short learning note.
